nodes.description: Private uint256 lottery random number, seeded at deployment from keccak256(now) % 10 + 1 and refreshed after every StartGame call.
Public uint256 tracking the contract balance advertised as the prize fund.
Public uint256 minimum bet required to play, default 0.1 ether, mutable by owner.
Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment and used by onlyOwner.
Public GameHistory[] array recording player address and guessed number for each game.
External onlyOwner function that updates the minBet state variable.
Public payable game entry point: validates bet and guess, logs history, pays the entire contract balance to a winning guesser, then reseeds randomNumber.
Public onlyOwner function transferring an arbitrary amount to the owner.
Unnamed payable fallback that accepts plain ether transfers into the lottery pot and can receive reentrant callbacks.
Caller-controlled address used as owner initialization, game player, and transfer recipient.
now (block.timestamp) used as keccak256 entropy source for the lottery random number, miner-manipulable.
External call sending the full contract balance to the caller-controlled address on a winning guess; state is updated after the call, enabling reentrancy.
External transfer of a caller-supplied amount to the owner address inside withdaw.
New minimum bet value supplied to changeMinBet.
Player's guessed number supplied to StartGame.
Amount supplied to withdaw for transfer to the owner.
Memory GameHistory struct built in StartGame and pushed into the log array.

edges.reason: owner state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner modifier gates changeMinBet on require(msg.sender == owner).
_newMinBet parameter is written into the minBet state variable.
_number parameter flows into StartGame as the player's guess.
msg.sender is used as the player address and bet sender in StartGame.
StartGame builds the gameHistory local struct.
gameHistory local variable is pushed onto the log state array.
randomNumber is derived from keccak256(now), a timestamp-dependent weak randomness source.
StartGame recomputes randomNumber from keccak256(now) after each play.
The full-balance transfer to the player is conditioned on the guessed number matching randomNumber.
StartGame executes the full-balance external transfer before finishing its own state updates.
The payable fallback can re-enter the contract during msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) since balance is read before state is settled.
prizeFund is assigned from this.balance inside StartGame.
withdaw is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender against owner.
_am parameter determines the amount transferred in withdaw.
withdaw performs the owner.transfer(_am) unsafe external operation.
owner address is the recipient of the transfer in withdaw.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only feeds the minBet assignment inside changeMinBet and carries no independent semantics.
Player guess parameter is consumed exclusively by StartGame for logging and comparison against randomNumber.
Withdrawal amount parameter is only used to size the owner.transfer call inside withdaw.
Temporary GameHistory struct exists solely as scratch space before being pushed to the log array in StartGame.
